mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating demand, which lowers earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing output, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.75 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.75pp in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A co-movement between rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a deepening labor market downturn, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls jointly (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1% each signals deteriorating demand across consumption and investment channels, which lowers earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS and HOUST both fall > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month increase in the industrial production index above 2% signals a robust manufacturing expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 2% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).
